pageHeadHtml:
Awards & Distinctions

Competitively adjudicated, external recognitions since MBBS. Undergraduate distinctions and subject prizes are on the CV, not listed here. Faculty Fellow (KCDH-A) is a position, not an award — see the homepage.
pageBodyHtml:
• RSNA Trainee Research Prize (MSK), Chicago — 2023. For the AIRib pipeline — automated rib-fracture detection and characterisation on CT (MD-thesis work, AIIMS Delhi × IIT Jodhpur).
  • Young Achiever in Radiology — National Diagnostic Summit, Mumbai — 2024.
  • GAIMS Global Healthcare Achievers' Award — 2022.
  • Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Award (FAIMACON) — 2022.
  • IMA MSN Chairman's National Award — 2021.
  • Delhi Doctors' Forum — Young Doctor of the Year — 2021.
